title: Range sums with a Fenwick tree
description:
Answer "sum from i to j" quickly while values change.

```
values: 5 2 9 1 7 3
sum(1..4) = 17
add 10 at 3 -> sum(1..4) = 27
sum(2..6) = 32
```
hints: `for (; i < size; i += i & -i) m_tree[i] += delta;` and `for (; i > 0; i -= i & -i) sum += m_tree[i];` (lesson 4.04).
`i & -i` is the lowest set bit of `i`, which is how far each step jumps.
requirements: `class Fenwick(n)` with `add(i, delta)` and `prefix(i)`, both O(log n), 1-based.
Check against a plain loop for a few random queries.
stretch: Write a segment tree that answers range minimums instead.
